text:
maria: Heads up — CloudEdge channel invoice CE-2026-07 looks like it's double-counting AWS Marketplace usage for June. Our ledger shows 1,200,000 embedding units but AWS MP invoice + channel invoice sum to the same units twice. Can someone check asap?

alisha: Can you paste the two invoice lines and the ledger snapshot?

maria: Sure — excerpt below. I grabbed CSV from billing exports.

```
Invoice: MP-70612 (AWS Marketplace)
  Line: EMBEDDINGS-UNIT - 1,000,000 units - $12,000
Invoice: CE-2026-07 (CloudEdge reseller)
  Line: MARKETPLACE_PASSTHROUGH - 200,000 units - $2,400
Ledger usage (June): 1,200,000 units
```

kevin: Quick Q — is the partner supposed to invoice pass-through lines *and* list marketplace usage? Contract usually says partner should net marketplace charges (pass-through) not duplicate. Which partner is this again?

maria: CloudEdge (approved reseller). Their invoice explicitly labels 200k as "marketplace passthrough" but the MP invoice already billed the 200k. Looks like they didn't net it out.

ben: I skimmed the reseller agreement — section 4.2 permits pass-through but requires partner to offset marketplace charges. Looks like a billing ops mistake on their side.

aws-billing-bot: AWS MARKETPLACE NOTE: Purchase token found: tok-89a7. Order MP-70612 includes 1,000,000 embedding units. No refund/reversal recorded.

alisha: Okay — two actions: 1) stop any AR collection for the duplicated amount until we confirm, 2) request partner adjustment or AWS reversal. Suggest provisional credit for the customer for $2,400 to avoid customer-facing issues.

kevin: I'll open a partner ticket and an AWS case. Kevin: created ticket PART-4472 -> asking CloudEdge to issue credit note and resubmit net invoice. Also opened AWS case AWS-INC-9923 to validate the purchase token mapping.

maria: GL/ops question — which GL should the provisional credit hit? Marketplace passthrough should map to 4102, reseller revenue to 4010. If we apply provisional credit, we should mirror the partner's line (4102) so month close isn't impacted.

ben: Agree. Use 4102 for the temporary posting and tag as 'provisional refund pending partner credit'.

alisha: I'll notify AR: please hold collection on CE-2026-07 and mark as disputed for $2,400.

kevin: Update from PART-4472 (CloudEdge): partner acknowledged error, will issue a credit note E-CREDIT-789 within 3 business days. AWS case AWS-INC-9923 says marketplace shows single invoice for 1,000,000 units and cannot issue a reversal unless partner initiates a refund flow.

maria: Great — can we apply the provisional credit now? We don't want month-end recognitions to be wrong.

alisha: Yes — finance ok to apply provisional credit. Maria, can you create journal? Include narration: "Provisional credit for duplicated marketplace passthrough on CE-2026-07 pending partner credit E-CREDIT-789".

maria: Done. Journal JN-2026-091 created — credit $2,400 to AR (CE-2026-07) and debit 4102. Posted as provisional.

kevin: I'll follow up with partner and confirm when credit note is issued. Once CloudEdge provides E-CREDIT-789, we'll reverse the provisional entry and update payment status.

ben: FYI — recommend we add a small validation to partner invoice onboarding: deny upload if 'marketplace passthrough' lines duplicate marketplace invoice tokens. Filing a small ops ticket for devs.

alisha: Good idea. I've added a checkbox to the backlog for invoice ingestion team: "detect duplicate marketplace passthroughs".

maria: Closing for now — provisional credit posted, AR on hold, partner will issue credit. Kevin will update thread when E-CREDIT-789 arrives. Thanks all :thumbsup:
